mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM proj_project_gate WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND project_id = #{query.projectId} AND stage_code = #{query.stageCode} AND gate_type = 'EXIT' AND deleted = b'0' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE proj_project_gate SET status = #{query.targetStatus}, version = version + 1, updater = #{query.updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.gateId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND status = #{query.expectedStatus} AND deleted = b'0'
